name: search_offers
description: Search this week's or next week's supermarket offers (Netto, Lidl, REMA 1000, føtex, Bilka, 365discount, SuperBrugsen, Brugsen, Kvickly, SPAR, MENY). Returns price, price per kg/l/piece, validity dates and an ingredient tag. "everydayPrice" marks permanent low prices rather than weekly deals.

query.description: Ingredient or product to look for, in English or Danish (e.g. "salmon", "kyllingebryst"). Omit to browse.

categories.description: Only return offers in these categories.

items.description: One of: meat, poultry, fish, vegetarian_protein, vegetables, fruit, carbs, dairy, pantry, ready_meal, snacks, beverages, non_food.

chains.description: Only return offers from these chains.

items.description: One of: netto, lidl, rema1000, foetex, bilka, coop365, superbrugsen, brugsen, kvickly, spar, meny, lovbjerg, abclavpris.

week.description: Which ISO week to search: "current", "next" or an ISO week like "2026-W45". Defaults to "current".

validOn.description: Only offers valid on this date (YYYY-MM-DD, Danish time).

dinnerRelevantOnly.description: Skip snacks, drinks and other non-dinner items. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return. Defaults to 20.

name: get_offer
description: Get full details of one offer, including its product image URL.

offerId.description: Offer id as returned by search_offers.

name: nutrition_lookup
description: Compute nutrition for a recipe from the Danish Frida food database. Pass every ingredient with its raw weight; returns per-ingredient matches and totals (kcal, protein, fat, saturated fat, carbs, sugars, fiber, salt). Check "unmatched" and low-confidence matches.

items.description: Every ingredient of one recipe with its raw weight.

ingredient.description: Plain English ingredient name, e.g. "chicken breast", "rice", "olive oil".

grams.description: Raw weight in grams for the whole recipe.

name: get_preferences
description: Get the household's members with allergies, dislikes, likes and diets, plus planning settings (dinners per week, servings, cooking time, preferred chains, budget).

name: update_preferences
description: Change the household's preferences: allergies, dislikes, likes or diet for a member, planning settings, or household notes. Only call this when the user explicitly asks for a change.

member.description: Household member the change applies to (first name). Required for allergies, dislikes, likes and diet.

diet.description: Diet description such as "pescetarian"; null clears it. May be null.

items.description: One of: netto, lidl, rema1000, foetex, bilka, coop365, superbrugsen, brugsen, kvickly, spar, meny, lovbjerg, abclavpris.

addNotes.description: Household-wide notes, e.g. "We cook bigger portions on Sundays".

name: get_meal_history
description: List recently planned or cooked dinners with ratings, to avoid repeating dishes and main proteins.

weeks.description: How many weeks back to look. Defaults to 8.
